texts.preamble: Mohd Maroof And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 February, 2024 High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:26760 Court No. - 89 Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 39317 of 2023 Applicant :- Mohd Maroof And Another Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Mohammad Farooque Ansari
texts.facts: The complaint was filed by the competent officer, which is appended at Mohd Maroof And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/19038384/ 1 page-24 of the paper book and on this complaint the A.C.J.M. concerned has written only two words 'darj register'. It is submitted that this order dated 09.05.2023 is a non-speaking order. Nothing has been mentioned regarding the offence against the applicants and without passing any order for summoning the accused directly vide order dated 09.06.2023 bailable- warrants of Rs.20,000/- have been issued against the applicants. Learned A.G.A., however, accepted that the order dated 09.05.2023 is a non-speaking order. From the perusal of the record, it is found that a complaint was registered against the applicants, whereon the concerned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate vide order dated 09.05.2023 ordered to register the complaint.
texts.arguments: It is argued by the learned counsel for the applicants that this is a case under Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. It is not disputed that directly bailable warrants can be issued against the applicants rather the argument of the learned counsel for the applicants is that without taking cognizance no process can be issued against the applicants.
texts.petitioner_arguments: It is argued by the learned counsel for the applicants that this is a case under Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. It is not disputed that directly bailable warrants can be issued against the applicants rather the argument of the learned counsel for the applicants is that without taking cognizance no process can be issued against the applicants.
